dedupe_keys.name: power flow data of ieee 118 bus system

description: Evgeny Tsydenov and Anton Prokhorov publish a pipeline and processed cases for an IEEE-118-like electricity network. The Zenodo software record is open under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; its linked GitHub release lists a separate 486 MB dataset archive. The README describes 118 buses, 186 branches, 91 loads and 321 generators, with hourly power-flow cases for one year. The pipeline parses, transforms and builds cases with PandaPower from an extended renewable-rich test system and supplementary IEEE-118 parameters. Modellers can use these cases to test flow, static security or operating scenarios. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this exact case series. Coverage is a constructed test grid, not the measured operation of a named utility. A limitation is that upstream source assumptions and noncommercial share-alike rights need review before combining the cases with other inputs. The archive was not downloaded, and neither yearly completeness nor flow convergence was recalculated.
